description: On the table in front there’s a baking tray with a powdered donut and a small gray shaker, a blue bowl with a red item and a green die, a phone, and a blue plastic fork. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand moves in from the right, grasps the donut on the tray as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it rightward to the bowl, then lowers and releases it into the bowl.
